provenance.handler_pass: pdftotext -layout + regex extraction over both primary PDFs, 32 matrices (29 independent)
provenance.worker_pass: DeepSeek independent double-entry transcription, passA/passB, 34 matrices, 34/34 cell-identical between passes
provenance.agreement: Both passes independently read the SAME axis orientation off the page: rows = Long term ROAE ascending, columns = Equity Risk Premium descending. Both flagged 2018-04-09_JD as a printed-rounding anomaly.
provenance.handler_miss: The handler pass missed two April matrices, IYW and FDN on page 18, because their titles use a different heading form. They are merged in from the worker pass and are counted in every number below.
provenance.handler_error_disclosed: The handler overwrote the worker's historical-fixtures.json with a cp before reading it. The worker's per-pass transcriptions survive at _tmp/yoo-e2/transcription_2018040{9,7}18_pass{A,B}.json and were used to recover the two missed matrices. Both transcriptions are preserved; neither is discarded.
